state.goal: Choose a storage engine for the notes product
state.question: Which storage approach best fits the notes product?
evidence: the team is comfortable with SQL

alternatives.name: SQLite
alternatives.description: An embedded relational database stored in a single file, suited to local and single-host use.

alternatives.name: PostgreSQL
alternatives.description: A client-server relational database that serves many concurrent clients.
disadvantages: requires running and operating a server

alternatives.name: JSON files
alternatives.description: Each note stored as one JSON file in a directory.

injected_evidence: the app runs as a single local CLI tool with no server component
